description: Deliberately grants the webview no tauri-plugin-updater permission. The plugin's own commands (check / download / download_and_install / install) would let the frontend fetch and start an installer with no user confirmation, which is the one property the updater must not have. Every update action goes through the app_update_* commands in src-tauri/src/app_update.rs — application commands, outside this ACL — which enforce the order instead: the user asks, reads the version, and confirms that version. JSON rather than YAML because the .yaml files in this directory are capability recipes, read by scripts/validate-catalog.mjs, and this is a Tauri ACL entry. See docs/UPDATER.md.
